title: PacGAN m=4 Packed Critic on Unequal-Mass Ring (2% Rare Mode)
intuition: Applies a PacGAN m=4 packed discriminator to a 5-mode ring with weights [40%, 30%, 20%, 8%, 2%], testing whether packing preserves rare 2% mode survival (min_mode_mass >= 0.01) without distorting overall mass TV.
failure_mode: The 2% mode appears in only ~8% of m=4 packed tuples, allowing uncalibrated critics to ignore or over-equalize it.
